title: Policy question, then asks for a person

turns.customer: Quick question before I use Paylane for something big: how do refunds work? Is there a limit?
turns.reply: Each transaction is judged on its own, and there's no overall cap. I can refund a card purchase myself if it has settled, is $75.00 or less, is under 30 days old, hasn't been refunded before and your card isn't frozen. Anything over $75, 30 or more days old, or sent to another person goes to our support team to review. I can't say what they'll decide.
